Subject: OptiFin onboarding: API enablement & console walkthrough

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for signing up and for the chat last week. We want to get your team into production quickly, so I’m proposing a 90-minute onboarding session next week that covers:

- Console walkthrough (project setup, model catalog, routing policies)
- API enablement (auth, example calls, streaming + function calling)
- KMS/HSM & data isolation overview
- Short Q&A and follow-up checklist (mutual action items)

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-07-13 15:00–16:30
- Wed 2026-07-14 09:00–10:30

If neither works, share 2–3 windows that suit your team (we’ll do our best to accommodate). Please include whoever will own implementation — I recommended looping in your platform engineer.

I’ve attached a short API_quickstart.pdf and the console-playbook.md to give your engineer a head start.

Agenda + calendar invite will go out once we lock a time. I’ll have Dev Patel (Solutions Eng) on the call to run the API demo.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
